name: get_sec_filing_text
description: Fetches section text from SEC 10-K, 10-Q, or 8-K filings from EDGAR.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, NVDA, MSFT)

name: get_financial_statements
description: Retrieves standardized Balance Sheet, Income Statement, and Cash Flow Statement line items.

description: Calculates institutional unlevered DCF, Reverse DCF, and sensitivity matrix.

starting_fcf.description: Base year unlevered free cash flow in millions

terminal_growth_rate.description: Perpetual terminal growth rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.025)
